title: Northgate Protect Food-Loss Limit for Higher-Value Refrigerators and Freezers
content:
On a Northgate Protect Standard-tier food-loss payment, the per-claim food-loss limit is raised by the limit of liability registered on the plan:

| Limit of liability registered on the plan | Per-claim food-loss limit |
|---|---|
| $2500.00 or more | Raised to the high food-loss limit, $400.00 |
| $1500.00 or more but below $2500.00 | Raised to the middle food-loss limit, $300.00 |
| Below $1500.00 | Not raised |

The registered limit is the total of the limit-of-liability registrations for the covered item on the plan's ledger.

## Both sides of each floor (hypothetical registered limits)

- $2500.00: $400.00. $2499.99: $300.00.
- $1500.00: $300.00. $1499.99: not raised.

*Hypothetical:* a French-door refrigerator registered at $2,740.00 has a per-claim food-loss limit of $400.00, so a food loss of $360.00 is held within it in full.
